Q: First of all, congratulations, Phainon, on your twelfth championship title!

I would say I am very privileged to be able to compete for 15 years in the sport, and to be able to win as many races and championships. It’s truly a blessing. One that I am very grateful for. It’s a feeling that I want to remember for sure. 

 

Q: Wonderfully said. Phedes, how about you? How was your race?

 

PHEDES: Oh man, I thought I was going to explode from the nerves. [Laughs] It was a great battle. I kept repeating in my head to not make any mistakes because the last thing I want to do is crash both of us out of the race again.

THEOPIS: Ah my race was quite boring, no? I was just enjoying the battle in front of me, I can’t lie.

THEOPIS: Yeah, exactly! I had front row seats to one of the most exciting battles this season and I enjoyed it a lot. 

 

———

 

PHAINON: Actually, before we end the press conference, can I make an announcement?

 

Q: Of course, go ahead. 

 

PHAINON: [Smiling sadly] It is with a heavy heart that I announce that this season will be my last season in MotoGP. I would like to take the time to thank all the fans that have supported me throughout all the years of my career. My team, my teammates from the past and present. I wouldn’t be here without all of them. I am very grateful to every single one of you that have stood by me through all these years. I officially announce my retirement from MotoGP, effective tonight.
